Fetching country metadata via World Bank API and filtering aggregates. I will exclude entries with region.id == 'NA' (World Bank convention for aggregates) and also require a non-empty capitalCity as a heuristic for sovereign entities.

```python
import requests
import pandas as pd

# Fetch all countries metadata
meta_url = 'https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country?format=json&per_page=400'
resp = requests.get(meta_url)
resp.raise_for_status()
meta = resp.json()
records = meta[1]

df_c = pd.DataFrame(records)
# Exclude aggregates (region.id == 'NA') and keep entries with a capital city
mask = df_c['region'].apply(lambda r: isinstance(r, dict) and r.get('id') != 'NA') & (df_c['capitalCity'].astype(str) != '')
df_c = df_c[mask].copy()

# Keep key fields and save
df_c[['id','iso2Code','name','region','adminregion','incomeLevel','capitalCity']].to_json('wb_countries_filtered.json', orient='records')
df_c[['id','name']].to_csv('wb_countries_filtered.csv', index=False)
print(f"Filtered sovereign-like entities: {len(df_c)}")
print(df_c[['id','name']].head())
```

Now pulling NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS for 2001–2010 for the filtered ISO3 codes and constructing a wide table (countries x years).

```python
import requests
import pandas as pd
import time

countries = pd.read_csv('wb_countries_filtered.csv')
iso3_list = countries['id'].tolist()

rows = []
for iso in iso3_list:
    url = f"https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/{iso}/indicator/NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS?date=2001:2010&format=json&per_page=120"
    r = requests.get(url)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        continue
    data = r.json()
    if not isinstance(data, list) or len(data) < 2 or data[1] is None:
        continue
    for entry in data[1]:
        if entry is None: continue
        country = (entry.get('country') or {}).get('value')
        date = entry.get('date')
        value = entry.get('value')
        if country and date:
            rows.append({'Country': country, 'Year': int(date), 'Value': value})
    time.sleep(0.05)

long_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
# Pivot to wide format
wide_df = long_df.pivot_table(index='Country', columns='Year', values='Value', aggfunc='first')
# Keep only 2001-2010 columns
years = list(range(2001, 2011))
wide_df = wide_df.reindex(columns=years)
wide_df.to_csv('gross_savings_2001_2010_by_country.csv')
print("Rows:", wide_df.shape[0], "Cols:", wide_df.shape[1])
print(wide_df.head())
```

```python
import pandas as pd

wide = pd.read_csv('gross_savings_2001_2010_by_country.csv')

mask_complete = wide[years].notnull().all(axis=1)
complete = wide[mask_complete].copy()

# Strictly greater than 35
qual = complete[(complete[years] > 35).all(axis=1)]

candidates = sorted(qual['Country'].tolist())
print("Preliminary candidates:", candidates)
```
